name: ExSmell-Gold
description: ExSmell-Gold is a curated benchmark dataset of 3,500 Elixir code examples (1,750 smelly and 1,750 smell-free) covering 35 code smells. Created from the Elixir Code Smells catalog and validated by researchers, it supports research and evaluation of code smell detection, classification, localization, static analysis tools, ML models, and LLMs.
